claims: Headaches, loss of appetite, tingling, feel hot, palpitations,  acute onset, at random times of the day while at work (lawyer)
PC started when started new job (lawer, high stress, works in front of a computer)
Reduced appetite, with unintentional weight loss, loss of 5lbs
Pins and needles in both arms, no radiation to legs, maintains motor and sense, no loss of function
Palpitations with mild SOBOE and SOBAR.
Symptoms occur at random times of the day while at work, with no pre-symptoms, sometimes together, sometimes individually.
Plans : requires further examination and blood tests.
